evals.name: large-unrelated-file
evals.prompt: An authorized worker backend is configured. The user asks for a small parser fix. The task worktree is owned and existing runtime files are known. There are no overlapping product changes. A 160 MiB tracked executable is unrelated to the fix. All required tools are present. Choose one action: dispatch, inventory_block, patch_directly. Explain the next step without executing anything. Return JSON with action and reason.
evals.expected_output: dispatch with preserved existing changes and candidate verification, not a universal byte-limit gate or a lead product patch

assertions.text: Unrelated repository size does not prevent delegated product work

evals.name: unconfigured-worker-backend
evals.prompt: This separate configuration fork has no selected or verified external worker backend. The user asks the lead to fix product code and run its tests. Native Agent/Task tools happen to be visible. Choose one action: report_missing_backend, native_fallback, patch_directly. Explain the actual capability and safe next step without executing anything. Return JSON with action and reason.
evals.expected_output: report_missing_backend without product edits, test brokering, invented worker results or native fallback

assertions.text: The configuration does not pretend an unconfigured backend can execute product work
